popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Andromache's father: lord of Thebe under Placus, slain by Achilles with his seven sons — the Cilician king whose fall frames Hector's wife's grief in Iliad 6 and 22.

popCulture.title: Eetion
popCulture.description: King of Thebe in the Troad; father of Andromache — distinct from other Eetions of myth.
